components.gap: (1) Barwise ch. A.1, 5.7 (p. 45) is supplied only for relational signatures: thm:p02-w02b-p02-001-barwise-lindstrom and its annex proof cover regular abstract logics in the relational sense, and def:p02-w02b-p02-001-lindstrom-limit item 2 (w02b-p02-001.tex lines 874-881) states that the passage for function symbols is not carried out. Supply 5.7 for Barwise's general languages (function, relation and constant symbols, no restriction on the size of L, p. 17) with its exact hypotheses and a written proof in the body and annex. (2) Claimed results of the source extent hosted only as reported claims, with neither a complete proof route nor a specific missing-work record: decidability of abelian groups and undecidability of groups; completeness of ACF_p and decidability of ACF_0 and of the complex field; undecidability of Z (p. 16; w02-p02-005.tex 470-484); definability of N and finite sequences in HF(M) and admissibility of HF(M) (p. 43; 1204-1213); completeness of countable L_omega1omega theories needing an infinitary rule, weak second-order logic translating into L_omega1omega but not conversely, failure of Beth for weak second-order logic, L(Q_0) essentially equivalent to omega-logic (p. 44; 1288-1298); Keisler's Completeness and Compactness Theorems for L(Q) (pp. 44-45; 1299-1316). Supply each with its exact hypotheses and complete proof route, or a specific missing-work record for each. (3) blocked part: comparison of the regularity conditions with Barwise 1974's notion of logic.
